## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. 
*Example: Users should be able to download invoice data as a CSV file from their dashboard.*

## 💡 User Story / Problem Statement
- **As a:** [Type of user, e.g., Billing Manager]
- **I want to:** [Action they want to take, e.g., export my monthly statements]
- **So that I can:** [Value/Benefit, e.g., easily reconcile expenses in Excel]

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution / Implementation Details
*Provide a detailed description of how you envision this feature working. Include any technical ideas, UI/UX layouts, or architectural impacts if known.*

- Component/Module affected: 
- Suggested approach: 

## 📋 Acceptance Criteria
*What needs to be true for this feature to be considered complete?*
- [ ] Users can see a "Download CSV" button on the billing history page.
- [ ] Clicking the button triggers a background download without reloading the page.
- [ ] The generated file includes fields: `Date`, `Invoice ID`, `Amount`, and `Status`.

## 🎨 Visuals & Context (Optional)
*Add any mockups, wireframes, screenshots, or links to references that help illustrate the feature.*

## ⚠️ Alternatives Considered
*A clear description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.*
